notes: The Recess Queen is a story about playground bullying and the power of friendship and kindness. Mean Jean dominates the playground until a new girl, Katie Sue, befriends her. Key vocabulary focuses on playground equipment (swing, jump rope, ball), social-emotional concepts (mean, kind, scared, friend), and playground context (recess, playground, push, turn). 'Scared' maps best to 'afraid' in Boardmaker. 'Kind' has no perfect Boardmaker match — 'beautiful' or 'good' may be the closest; consider a custom icon. The word 'recess' may need a custom icon if not found in the library. Secondary character Katie Sue could also be sourced if a named-character fringe slot is desired, but she was not included in the 11 fringe words in favour of more functional vocabulary.
